paragraphs.text: MiniMax token-plan quota dock for DSH web — drop-shape 5h usage %, click for detail panel, auto-hide
MiniMax token-plan quota dock for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web.
Shows a drop-shape icon + 5h **usage %** in the conversation input area (next to the model selector)
. Click for a detail panel listing every model's 5h & weekly usage, reset countdown, and absolute nu
mbers. Auto-hides when the active default model is not a MiniMax model.
This plugin requires a MiniMax API key. Export it before launching `dsh web`:
Or put it in your shell rc (`~/.zshrc`, `~/.bashrc`).
